content: Krishna Das reached out to Vikram Patel regarding a significant increase in their insurance renewal premium. Vikram explained it was due to new benefits and rising medical costs. Krishna requested information on more cost-effective alternative plans, provided their age (32) and stated they have no pre-existing conditions, and asked about the status of their currently expired policy.

action_items: Vikram to check alternative cost-effective plans
Vikram to explain policy status after expiration
